light.method: 内置 image_gen AI 绘画
light.prompt: Create a premium original wide landscape desktop theme artwork, 16:9, target 3840x2160. Use BOTH attached character references: reference 1 is Xiaoguo, reference 2 is Daguo. Preserve Xiaoguo's round navy-blue body, huge glossy blue open eyes, white eye patches and oval belly, tiny gold beak/feet, TWO glossy head tufts. Daguo is 18 percent larger with broad white face mask, SINGLE short tuft, cheerful winking eye and smiling golden beak; convert his hand-drawn reference into matching beautifully polished soft 3D toy rendering while keeping his distinctive face. Show BOTH fully visible together, close enough to feel a duo, in RIGHT HALF of image: Xiaoguo on left operating a small physical blank-button maker device, Daguo to right holding out a little golden spanner and waving, joyful collaborative interaction. Build a delightful miniature floating blue-and-white workshop base with curved glass window, a tiny plant, blue spherical lamp, tactile white ceramic and soft resin materials. Early morning sunlight, baby-blue sky, gentle distant clouds, believable soft contact shadows, cinematic physically based 3D animation-film quality. Pair's faces centered around x=73%, y=43%; both entire bodies inside x=52%-92%, y=20%-80%, fully framed, no cropping. Left 43% is calm atmospheric pale ice blue studio wall, subtle meaningful depth, room for interface later; right half detailed but curated. Charming expression, flawless anatomy, polished art direction. Art only, NO text, logos, app UI, panels, windows of software, buttons of software, labels, screenshots, watermark. Characters' bodies should be round penguins without human fingers. Keep both characters visually distinct, not two scaled copies.
